question.prompt: In right triangle \(ABC\), the hypotenuse has length \(AB=10\). How long is the median \(CD\) to the hypotenuse? (Enter only the number.)

solutions.explanation: The median to the hypotenuse of a right triangle is half the length of the hypotenuse, so \(CD=10\div2=5\).
solutions.title: Apply the hypotenuse-median theorem
